takeaway: Computer-use agents are now a tracked direction: 14 apps, led by vercel-labs/agent-desktop, which gained 2,316 stars today. The radar's forecasts held their recovery (53% of the top 15 right for Oct 29).

findings.heading: Computer-use becomes a direction
findings.text: Agents that operate a desktop, browser or phone led new growth three days running. The new direction has 14 apps, 43% of them in the top quartile; agent-desktop went from 13,394 to 15,710 stars.

findings.heading: The forecast recovery held
findings.text: The Oct 29 ranking scored a rank correlation of 0.66 and 53% of its top 15 across 95 apps, after 0.70 and 60% for Oct 28. Random picks would get about 16%.

findings.heading: DeepSeek's agent repo cools; its ecosystem doesn't
findings.text: dsh-superagent-prototype gained 1,343 stars (after 3,075 and 4,732), while the dsh-Go phone client gained 1,934 to pass 10,000.

findings.heading: A background agent more than doubles
findings.text: KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop, created Nov 3, went from 1,296 to 2,841 stars. It lets a command-line agent take on and follow up work on its own, asking only when unsure.

findings.heading: One computer-use leader to treat with caution
findings.text: modelflare-ai/AnyModelBot has 2,703 stars but only 32 forks (1.2%), far below other new agent repos; it ranks second in the new direction.

caveats: No company figure was recorded today; the one candidate counted usage, not users or revenue.
The first forecast built mostly on the radar's own API measurements is scored on Nov 8.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
